title: Air Light Brazilian Red Cabbage Hash
description: A light and refreshing Brazilian dish featuring red cabbage, perfect for a sick day, with herbal notes and a low FODMAP profile.

ingredients.name: garlic-infused oil
ingredients.notes: for flavor, use garlic-free for strict FODMAP

instructions: Shred the red cabbage into thin strips and set aside.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shredded onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic-infused oil and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shredded red cabbage to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to wilt.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped parsley and mint.
Use a spatula to gently fold the mixture over on itself, creating a light and airy texture.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the cabbage is tender but still crisp.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
